name: pin-input
title: Pin Input
summary: A one-time code or PIN typed one character per box.
description: A one-time code or PIN typed one character per cell. Each cell is the Input made square (xs 24 · sm 28 · md 32 · lg 36px; 40px on touch), its character centred. Typing moves to the next cell, Backspace to the previous one, a pasted or suggested code fills every cell at once. Behaviour by Ark UI's pin-input (Zag). Controlled or uncontrolled.

anatomy.description: Ark's pin-input root: a column, the label above the cells.
Visible name (the label prop): text.sm, medium, ink, as the Field's label; it also names the group and every cell.
role=group, named by the label or aria-label. The cells in a row, 6px apart (4px up to 28px); they wrap rather than overflow a narrow container.

One cell: the Input (data-pin-input="input"), square (the size's height: 24, 28, 32 or 36px; 40×40 on a coarse pointer), centred tabular character, named "<label>, 2 of 6". Only one cell is in the tab order. data-filled, data-complete from the engine.
Ark's hidden input with the whole code, for a form (name).

value.description: One character per cell, "" for an empty one.

type.description: What a cell accepts; numeric also brings up the number keyboard.

mask.description: Dots instead of the characters (a PIN).

size.description: The Input's sizes (`lib/control.ts`): square cells of 24, 28, 32 or 36px. On a coarse pointer every cell is 40px.

variant.description: The shared control's looks (`lib/control.ts`), at every size. outline: the form field (field colour, hairline). subtle: the inspector (inset grey, no edge). ghost: nothing until touched. Focused, open and invalid look the same in every variant.

placeholder.description: Shown in an empty cell without focus.

invalid.description: The Input's red ring on every cell (aria-invalid).

name.description: Form field name (the hidden input holds the whole code).

events.valueComplete: (code: string) when every cell is filled

keyboard: Tab enters the first empty cell (one tab stop for the whole code)
Typing fills the cell and moves to the next; a character the type does not accept is ignored
Backspace clears the cell, or the previous one when it is empty; Delete clears the cell
Arrow Left / Arrow Right move between cells (mirrored right-to-left)
Paste fills every cell from the focused one
notes: The cells are named "<label>, 2 of 6"; the group is named by the label or aria-label.
otp sets autocomplete="one-time-code" and numeric sets inputmode=numeric, so phones offer the code they received.
The text is 16px on touch devices (the Input's rule), so iOS does not zoom.
To set it from outside, control `value`: React value / onValueChange.

motion: the Input's: rings over duration.base, fill over duration.fast (pointer hover only)
focus moves from cell to cell instantly
